name: majority
type: def majority : List A → CostM Cells (Option A) | [] => pure none | x :: xs => do ✓[Cells.alloc 2] do let result ← loop x 1 xs ✓[Cells.free 2] pure result where /-- Single-pass loop carrying the current candidate and counter as parameters — no allocation, no ticks. -/ loop (cand : A) (cnt : ℕ) : List A → CostM Cells (Option A) | [] => pure (some cand) | y :: ys => if y = cand then loop cand (cnt + 1) ys else if cnt = 0 then loop y 1 ys else loop cand (cnt - 1) ys /-- The loop has zero cost: it overwrites the two slots without allocating. -/

name: loop_cost
type: theorem loop_cost (cand : A) (cnt : ℕ) (xs : List A) : (majority.loop cand cnt xs).cost = 0
